result.title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
result.summary: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向等距柱状投影（ERP）全景图像的 patch 级深度视觉里程计，结合球面先验初始化的可变形特征提取、接缝感知的端到端估计与球面梯度 patch 选择，以降低纬度畸变和极点采样偏置的影响。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用球面几何先验引导可变形采样以保留空间结构的做法，可能为 LVR 中「几何与任务必要信息如何在内部表示中保真」提供可核查的线索；但工作本身是机器人视觉里程计，不涉及 latent 推理状态生成、证据使用或停止决策。
